segments.he: מַתְנִי' כׇּל הָרָאוּי לָדוּן דִּינֵי נְפָשׁוֹת — רָאוּי לָדוּן דִּינֵי מָמוֹנוֹת, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁרָאוּי לָדוּן דִּינֵי מָמוֹנוֹת וְאֵינוֹ רָאוּי לָדוּן דִּינֵי נְפָשׁוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Any» person «who is fit to adjudicate» cases of «capital law is fit to adjudicate» cases of «monetary law, and there are» those «who are fit to adjudicate» cases of «monetary law but are unfit to adjudicate» cases of «capital law.»

moves.summary: states the rule of fitness to judge

positions.claim: anyone fit to judge capital cases is fit for monetary cases; some are fit for monetary cases only
